records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Sorry we missed each other on Monday's onboarding call -- happy to work around your schedule.

If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them. That first project is usually all it takes to see what Wrenfield is for.

Would a short call this week help? Send me a couple of times that suit you and I'll set it up, or just reply here with where you're stuck and I'll point you in the right direction.

Best,
Chidi
